listing.name: Less Supplies for Maintenance
listing.summary: Reduces the monthly supplies cost for all ships by a factor of four.

description:
A simple mod to reduce the amount of supplies burnt by your fleet for maintenance.

Download

I feel like ships burn way too much supplies to exist, especially since there are dozens of NPC fleets with several capitals just roaming around the sector at all times. The entire sector would be empty of supplies if they followed the same rules as the player.

So I made this mod, it removes the feeling I had in mid game where one has to constantly earn credits just to maintain the fleet.

By default this mod divides the montly supplies cost of every ships, mods included, by 4. If you have LunaLib, there is a setting to choose the divider between 1 (no change) and 10 (big change).

No effect on reparation costs.

Safe to add and remove at any time.
